relations.rationale: Checking her watch is the action that would let Isla notice/announce the time remaining until the race starts.
Checking a watch is unrelated to whether the pack of cyclists surges forward.
Noting the race starts in fifteen minutes doesn't directly relate to whether the sun broke through when the horn sounded, though both concern timing of the race start loosely.
Being on different teams doesn't bear on relative race rankings from a previous year.
Team membership has no bearing on weather conditions at the start.
Spectators lining the fences near the final stretch is unrelated to the sun breaking through at the start.
Jun rejoining others near timing mats doesn't determine whether the pack surges forward onto the road.
If Hana ranked fourth, this directly supports the claim that she ranked just ahead of Isla, if Isla was fifth.
Hana ranking fourth doesn't itself confirm Isla's rank of fifth, though it's consistent with it.
Hana's past ranking is unrelated to whether the current pack of cyclists surges forward.
If Hana ranked just ahead of Isla, and Isla was fifth, this supports Isla's fifth-place finish being consistent, and reinforces the ranking relationship.
Isla's finish position in a previous year has no bearing on whether the sun broke through this year's start.
The sun breaking through as the horn sounded signals the race start, which supports the pack surging forward immediately after.
The pack surging forward onto the road directly leads into and supports them then disappearing around the first bend.
